definitions.short: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)
definitions.full: H5101. nahaq [ נָהַק ] verb bray, cry (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic bray (of ass); Aramaic נְהַק cry out (of men), נְהִיקָא braying ); — Qal Imperfect יִנְהַק Job 6:5 of wild ass; יִנְהָ֑קוּ 30:7 of cries of destitute outcasts.
